# Contributing to Ballerina Dev Website

Thank you for contributing to the Ballerina Dev Website! 🎉

## Ways to Contribute

- 🐛 Report bugs via [Issues](https://github.com/ballerina-platform/ballerina-dev-website/issues/new/choose)
- 💡 Suggest improvements
- 📖 Improve documentation or fix typos
- 🎨 Fix UI/UX issues

## Development Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/ballerina-dev-website.git
cd ballerina-dev-website
npm install
npm run dev
```

## Commit Message Convention

| Prefix | Use for |
|--------|---------|
| `feat:` | New features |
| `fix:` | Bug fixes |
| `docs:` | Documentation changes |
| `style:` | CSS/formatting (no logic change) |
| `refactor:` | Code restructuring |
| `chore:` | Maintenance / tooling |

**Example:** `docs: fix typo in installation guide`

## Opening a Pull Request

1. Create a branch: `git checkout -b feature/your-change`
2. Make focused, atomic commits
3. Run `npm run lint` before pushing
4. Open PR against the `master` branch of `ballerina-platform/ballerina-dev-website`
5. Fill in the PR template completely

## Issue Labels

| Label | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `good first issue` | Great for newcomers |
| `Type/Bug` | Something is broken |
| `Type/Improvement` | Enhancement request |
| `Area/BBE` | By-Examples related |
| `Area/UIUX` | UI/UX issues |
